english: Your companion lets out an audible gulp.
Bad room! Bad room! Old trial-chamber!
(Face the light with a straight back.)
Sorry! Meek is sorry, Meek did not think master would step into scary bright room...
His face grows red from anger. Or the lighting.
The words change tone and intensify - mimicking your own way of speech.
YOU HAVE STEPPED INTO THE FIFTH CHAMBER OF TRIALS.
TWO HAVE STEPPED INTO THE FIFTH CHAMBER OF TRIALS.
THIS WILL BE YOUR FINAL AND MOST MOUNTING CHALLENGE YET, OH CHAMPIONS OF THE HOST.
IF OUTSIDE AGAIN YOU WISH TO SEE - ANSWER ME THESE QUESTIONS THREE - THE ANSWER OF WHICH I SHALL JUDGE FAIRLY UPON THINE SOUL.
WHO WILL TAKE THE FIRST STEP?
You entered this mess- now you will handle it.
Damn it. Why'd you have to pick the scary red-light-cow-room...?
You must take the first step to answer three questions to finish the fifth trial...
What happens if I say the wrong answer?
Ask me your questions, guardian, I am not afraid.
(Remain silent and stare meekly at the statue.)
YOU WILL BE CAST INTO ETERNAL PERIL.
Do I have to answer all five questions correctly?
Three, okay, I got it. Do I have to answer all three questions correctly?
ANSWER ME QUESTIONS THREE - THE ANSWER OF WHICH I SHALL JUDGE FAIRLY UPON THINE SOUL.
Wait, are you a sentient type of trial-guardian, or are you more of the... Magic Mouth type?
Either it is a non-sentient statue, or it is a statue with a pre-cast Magic Mouth, yes.
The statue obviously has a Magic Mouth spell cast on it. It is programmed to react to certain types of inquiries, in the speaker's original tongue.
Do not think about it too much. Answering the questions in a straight manner will do just fine with this barbaric setup.
THE OTHER WILL NOT INTERFERE, OR THE TRIAL IS FAILED.
THE OTHER WILL HAVE A TURN OF THEIR OWN.
Six questions, got it. You go ahead, Cleric.
After a few seconds the voice continues, "THE CHOSEN WILL BE... YOU."
You're the cleric here! Deal with your magic talking statue- and do NOT get us killed.
Whatever is thrown your way- you will know the answer.
THE QUESTION WILL NOT BE REPEATED.
The goblin thinks about it for a second. Then he whispers back:
I don't think bovinefolk are known for either trick questions or riddles, so...
But what if that is not the answer?
Wouldn't it be funny if I said something completely unexpected here, and it turned out to be the correct answer?
The light blinds you for a moment, and you feel the chamber shake.
To solve the mystery of the Tea Shop that Blew Up.
Again the eyes of the cow glare into a fiery beam.
For a third time you feel that rumble, along with the hot gaze of the minotaur...
THE FIFTH TRIAL IS COMPLETE, CHAMPION.
It then turns to your companion.
Snell, in response, gives off a shocked scoff.
You can sense the relief pass over him.
Yeah. This was pretty stupid. All that buildup for nothing.
At least the cows know how to put on a show!
The goblin stands up straight, facing the light.
The eyes of the statue grow stronger once more.
You catch him glancing to the side for a second.
(Be quiet, and hope the goblin doesn't fuck this up.)
He waves a claw at you.
My quest is... to serve Lady Sageleaf.
Again, it rumbles, and you get to the crescendo of that final, third question.
WHAT IS THE SCHOLARLY DEFINITION OF NUMENISM?
It is the rule of GODS.
What is the scholarly definition of Numenism?
(Squat down and stare at the goblin as the light grows more intense.)
That depends. Arcane Era scholarly definition, or Divine Era scholarly definition?
If you had gotten this question, you probably would have short-circuited that Magic Mouth.
It doesn't matter. I can't give the answer to Snell.
Numenism is the governmental rule of divine dictatorship.
Numenism is the belief in the right of walking gods to rule mortals.
Numenism is when walking gods ruled the Coast.
The goblin has his eyes fixed on you as you hold up your hands.

(Pretend to act like a tyrannical magic-man with a big stick, then pretend to use magic to mind control your followers, then pretend to show how those followers slowly overcome you as way better Arcanists come into power through a fair system of meritocracy during the Arcane Era.)
(Pretend to pray, then pretend to be a big strong Urth, then pretend to show how people congregate into cultural units underneath god-kings during the Divine Era.)
His eyes are full of panic as you spend precious seconds waving your hands around.
But just to be clear, your miming here is ON point.
He is unable to even begin to focus on your attempt to communicate.
He opens his mouth to speak, still staring at you, dumbfounded.
Beneath you: a sea of spikes!
But somehow you do manage to stretch out - SPRAWL out - with your hands landing on rough stone, and your feet...
You're in a bit of a shitty position right now.
You want me to STAY like this?!
Let's just relax here. I'm sure there's a way to solve this.
The goblin attempts to take a step down your lower back.
You cannot hold this for long.
You don't have Spider Climb prepared?!
Why would I have <shake>Spider Climb</shake> prepared?
I don't know - why would you? I actually can't think of a single useful situation for it...!
You did use to have Spider Climb in your spellbook. Before the River took your collection.
Alas, you will have to do this the brutish way.
It is time to act. Take responsibility for the safety of this party.
Wait, if you fail at holding on...
Won't that kill you right away?
Hold out while you let Snell climb off.
You get the idea of what is down there.
As you attempt to look, a part of your mind very much so asks nicely: do not.
There is no need to conceptualize this threat, for its material reality does not change your position.
Your palms scrape against the rough stone. Your boots find purchase on the opposite wall.
The goblin clings to your back like a terrified cat.
Every muscle in your body screams.
The edge of the pit grows closer.
You shift your weight. Your right hand moves an inch.
But now you're stuck. Muscles locked. Unable to move forward or back.
Yet you're halfway there. You know it.
Keep going! You can do this!
Your muscles have given up on you entirely.
You hang there, suspended, unable to will yourself to move.
Give strength to your son. Let him avoid getting spiked to death like some common spelunker.
After a moment of deliberation, the goblin then scrambles up your back, using your helm as a stepping stone, and LEAPS for the edge of the pit.
His claws find purchase on the stone. He pulls himself up.
He shifts his weight to one side.
He takes another step. Your right hand loses grip.
For one terrible moment, you feel yourself falling.
Try to climb off. I got this.
The goblin lunges for the edge as your body drops.
You hit the spikes at an angle - your armor taking most of the impact.
LIKE A BUG ON A BOARD.
Many agonizing seconds later, the goblin manages to fish you out with a combination of his sling, parts of his shirt, and creative profanity.
STEP FORTH, AND CLAIM YOUR PRIZE - THE PLUNDERED EYE.
The voice starts up again as you do.
YOU HAVE BRAVED THE PIT OF WRONG ANSWERS.
I hate this place so much, your companion mutters to himself.
Again, just to reiterate, Snell says across the gap. "This place is somewhat dangerous."
Yeah, I guess you wouldn't know that.
The goblin gives you a frustrated, but ultimately relieved sigh.
Yeah, well. I- I am aware of that.
And I hope you realize that you got some soft-ball-fucking questions in contrast.
His face is red with anger. This time you're sure it's not because of the lighting.
Agreed. Not that it's that much of a surprise.
Esoteric bullshit talking statues tend to be filled with esoteric bullshit. Who would have thought?
Don't worry, that was some bullshit. Don't think even your new friend Snurre could psycho-analyze a decent answer to that.
Yeah, that was some bullshit. Don't worry, even if you did have the perfect answer, it'd just fuck us over some other way.
He slumps to his knees, an expression of relief on his face.
We're alive. That's all that matters.
The statue is now entirely silent, and you hear an esoteric boom coming from the drawer between its legs.
That sound - it unlocked. It was the exact noise an arcane seal makes during breaking.
Well done. The Minotaur's riddles are properly conquered!
A strange exercise. But one you met well.
To think of all the people who have met their end in a place like this.
Awesome. Let's see what kind of bling that cow is hiding...
Okay, let's see what the treasure is...
